callout.packets_body: Packets the supervisors have released, with the documents that have arrived for each one. When every document is in, check the packet and accept it. Accepted packets move to LC request.
callout.lc_request_body: Accepted packets that can have an LC request. Select the packets, build a bank schedule (the Excel schedule plus one invoice PDF per packet), review it, then mark it sent to the bank. The packets then wait in LC funded.
callout.lc_funded_body: Packets whose request is with the bank and not funded yet. When the bank funds one, mark it funded here with the date and amount. That moves it to Lists to Carmen and starts the Arm B clock.
callout.lists_body: Funded packets ready to go on a Production Journal, and the lists already sent. Create a list from the funded packets and send it to Carmen. Carmen then pays each account.
callout.carmen_body: Each list sent to Carmen, with the accounts she has paid and the ones still open. Wait for Carmen, or — if she has been out — confirm an account from the paper copy. When every account is paid, Arm A is closed for that list.
callout.arm_b_receivables_body: Claro paying JAF. Record payments as they land, then close the job once both exist. A half-closed job is normal here, not an error — the job closes for good when Claro's payment is in.
callout.arm_b_po_body: Record the Claro PO against the Aviso, then generate the final Claro document. Several POs per Aviso, and the Awaiting PO and Awaiting Ariba lists, arrive in the next Arm B phase.

callout.scan_in_body: Every unit that comes back is scanned here — its location updates the moment the barcode reads.
callout.scan_in_not_owed_body: Scan the serial of a unit that is owed back to this warehouse — the unit drops off the installer's owed-back list the moment it is scanned in.
callout.scan_in_done_body: Unit location updated to this warehouse. It is off the installer's owed-back list and back in your serialized stock.
callout.triage_body: Good units go back to stock, failures go to the repair pool, and anything uncertain is held for the lead.
callout.review_body: Resolving a hold is a lead judgment call — a short line changes what the crew can do on site.
callout.repairs_body: Failed units travel in a Claro repair batch. Send the batch, then record the intake when the repaired units come back.
callout.restock_body: Approved restocks release to the van through the dual-signature release — van stock moves when both sign.
callout.repairs_sent_body: The batch is with Claro. Record the intake here when the repaired units come back.
callout.repairs_doc_failed_body: The batch was sent, but its document did not render. Regenerate it from the batch list below.
callout.stock_body: Every movement carries actor, time and job. Adjustments need a reason; snapshots defend the count against audit.

callout.sign_body: Count each line together on one screen. The crew may take more — change the number. Both sign. The list locks for everyone.
callout.field_body: Do the job, then log it here: actual address, GPS, materials used, photos and your signature. What you save offline syncs when you reconnect.
callout.warehouse_list_body: Stage the materials (2), release them with both signatures (3), receive what comes back. Grey steps happen to the job, not to you.
callout.crew_list_body: Pick up at the warehouse, do the job, document it. Grey steps happen to the job but are not yours.
